name: Campaign Control Plane
one_liner: The executable portfolio dashboard that turns frozen theses into deterministic checkpoint DAGs and autonomous build experiments.
core_thesis: The correct unit of autonomous software construction is not a repository or a prompt; it is a typed behavioral checkpoint with explicit evidence, a deterministic validator, a dependency position, and an authority class. If each project is decomposed into such checkpoints, autonomous agents can iterate toward externally verifiable functionality while the human only resolves irreducible H-tasks and structural bottlenecks.
why_now: The underlying kernel pieces already exist: ATask records attempts and proof, Seed0 compares seeds, and QP separates cognition, truth and authority. The missing layer is a portfolio/campaign graph that compiles product theses into executable work.
job: See exactly what each project claims, what is proven, what is blocked, what agent should do next, and what only the human can resolve.
distribution: Internal control plane first; later reusable infrastructure for autonomous software factories.
moat: Accumulated validator library, checkpoint ontology, cross-project run data, bottleneck history and empirically learned routing policies.
falsifiers: Behavioral checkpoint decomposition does not reduce false-done rates.
Deterministic evidence is too expensive to capture relative to manual review.
Agent tournaments fail to produce measurable improvement over one guided agent.
